apps.journey: Browse, return to the same tab, and recover from a failed load.
Enter a long expression, correct it with the keyboard, and inspect the result.
Select an event, return to the same date, and distinguish local from synchronized data.
Grant or deny camera access, capture, then open the captured item.
Create an alarm, edit it, and keep a running timer understandable.
Open an exact message from Hub, reply from the correct account, and retain a failed draft.
Open an image from a grid, zoom, share, and return to the same grid position.
Search, deny location access, recover, and keep the selected destination on resize.
Open a conversation, retain a draft, send, and expose pending or failed delivery.
Select a track, change output route, and return to the same library position.
Capture from Hub, edit a note or task, undo deletion, and return to the same selection.
Find two people with the same name, open the right contact, and handle an incoming call.
Search for a setting, change its live value, return, and retain search and focus.
Read long output, select text, resize, and preserve the live session.
Invoke the assistant, inspect the requested action, cancel, and return to the caller.
Search the app catalogue, inspect a package, follow install progress or failure, and return to the same selection.
Start a new native app with the shared controls and explicit state handling.
Exercise diagnostics without treating test-only controls as product design.
